title: Question 2 — Customer request
prompt: What does the customer say they need?
hint: Find the customer's short request about money in the first lines of the conversation.
sample: I need to withdraw some money.

ja.prompt: お客様は何が必要だと言っていますか？
ja.hint: 会話の最初の方で、お客様が短くお金について頼んでいる文を探してください。
ja.sample: I need to withdraw some money.

local.prompt: What does the customer say they need?
local.hint: Find the customer's short request about money in the first lines of the conversation.
local.sample: I need to withdraw some money.

local_pron.prompt: wut duz thuh cus-tuh-mer say thay need?
local_pron.hint: find thuh cus-tuh-mer's short re-kwest uh-bout mun-ee in thuh furst lynz uhv thuh kon-ver-say-shun.
local_pron.sample: eye need too with-draw sum mun-ee

zh.hint: 在對話前幾句中找到客戶關於取款的簡短請求。
zh.sample: I need to withdraw some money.

en.prompt: What does the customer say they need?
en.hint: Find the customer's short request about money in the first lines of the conversation.
en.sample: I need to withdraw some money.

title: Question 3 — What was handed back?
prompt: What did the customer hand back after filling it out?
hint: The conversation says the customer filled out a form and then gave it back to the teller.
sample: They handed back the completed withdrawal slip.

ja.prompt: 記入した後、顧客は何を返しましたか？
ja.hint: 会話では、顧客が伝票に記入してそれを窓口係に渡したと書かれています。
ja.sample: They handed back the completed withdrawal slip.

local.prompt: What did the customer hand back after filling it out?
local.hint: The conversation says the customer filled out a form and then gave it back to the teller.
local.sample: They handed back the completed withdrawal slip.

local_pron.sample: they hand-ed bak thuh com-plee-ted with-drawl slip

zh.prompt: 填寫後，客戶交還了什麼？
zh.hint: 對話說客戶填寫了一張表格，然後把它交還給櫃員。
zh.sample: They handed back the completed withdrawal slip.

en.prompt: What did the customer hand back after filling it out?
